spans.text: This closes the only hole in the compute-in-the-OS design:

an object store cannot decide who deserves a credential. Everything else moved into the user's machine; this could not, because a customer who could mint their own credential could mint their own subscription.
It is a stateless request/response handler and it fits inside the Workers
plan — 100,000 requests/day, 10 ms CPU per invocation. If it grows past that, something has gone wrong with the design rather than with the plan.
